topic.source_contract: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning spatial layers

facts.zone_1: less than 0.1 percent annual probability and not shown
facts.scope_guard: Flood zones are planning-risk extents and not parcel permission, exact property risk or defence-performance evidence.

assumptions: no future defence or land-use changes
facts.scope_guard: The climate-change extent is a composite planning screen and not a prediction of exact future property flooding.
The national planning extents indicate area-level risk and are not suitable for determining whether an individual property will flood.
Climate-change scenarios are long-term planning indications and not current individual-property probabilities.
Depth bands are modelled planning evidence and are not measured damage, floor level, viability or safety scores.

scope_guards: Flood Zone 1 is the residual area outside the supplied Zone 2 and 3 polygons and is not represented by a separate polygon layer.
River and sea annual probabilities remain distinct and are not merged into a single parcel probability.
Flood-zone layers ignore the benefit of defences and therefore do not prove actual defended-site performance.
Flood Zones plus climate change is a screening layer for FRA and sequential-test needs, not exact future property flooding.
Surface-water AEP scenarios are area-level model outputs and are not individual-building probabilities.
Present-day and climate-change layers remain separate; RCP8.5 upper-end 2070s is not presented as current risk.
Depth bands are not converted into damage, viability, finished-floor or safety scores without site-specific assessment.
No score or promotion is written without exact candidate geometry, executed overlay, current FRA and planning evidence.
